prompt: Which of these thoughts shows a growth mindset?

options.text: 'I am just not a maths person'
'I cannot do this yet — practising will make it easier'
'Smart people never need to try hard'
'If I fail, it proves I am not clever'

explanation: A growth mindset treats ability as something that grows with practice and effort, so 'not yet' replaces 'I can't' — the word 'yet' keeps the door open.
